context: A tiny stdlib-only Python library that turns arbitrary titles into URL slugs and hands out unique slugs. Used by a static-site generator; correctness on Unicode input matters more than speed.
conventions: Python 3.9+ compatible: put `from __future__ import annotations` first in every module.
Type hints on every public function; a one-line docstring on every public symbol.
No I/O, no global mutable state.
integration_test_cmd: {python} -c "from slugkit.registry import SlugRegistry; r = SlugRegistry(); assert r.add('Café Crème') == 'cafe-creme'; assert r.add('cafe creme') == 'cafe-creme-2'"

units.title: Text normalisation helpers
units.goal: Two pure functions that the slug builder uses to clean text.

interface.contract: Remove combining marks (accents) and return the rest; characters without accents are unchanged.
Replace every run of whitespace with one ASCII space and strip both ends.

spec: strip_accents: apply unicodedata.normalize('NFKD'), drop every character for which unicodedata.combining(ch) != 0, then return unicodedata.normalize('NFC', result).
Because of NFKD, compatibility characters are decomposed (e.g. the ligature 'ﬁ' becomes 'fi'); because of the final NFC, scripts without combining marks (e.g. Hangul) come back unchanged.
collapse_whitespace: whitespace means str.isspace() (includes tabs, newlines, NBSP U+00A0, ideographic space U+3000).
slugkit/__init__.py contains only a module docstring: "slugkit - URL slugs."

units.title: Slug builder
units.goal: Build a URL slug from any text using the U1 helpers.

interface.signature: def slugify(text: str, *, sep: str = "-", max_len: Optional[int] = None) -> str
interface.contract: Return a lowercase ASCII slug of text, words joined by sep, at most max_len characters.

spec: Validate first: raise ValueError if sep == '' or if max_len is not None and max_len < 1.
Every maximal run of characters that are NOT ASCII letters a-z or digits 0-9 becomes one sep (this includes non-Latin letters such as Hangul).
Remove sep from both ends (no leading or trailing separator).
If max_len is given and the slug is longer, cut it to its first max_len characters, then remove trailing characters contained in sep (str.rstrip(sep)).
If nothing is left, return '' (not an error).
constraints: Use slugkit.normalize.strip_accents; do not re-implement accent stripping.
Use the re module for the character runs.

units.title: Unique slug registry
units.goal: A small class that hands out slugs that are unique within one registry.

interface.contract: Remembers every slug it handed out.
Empty registry; sep is used for slugify and for numeric suffixes.
Return a new unique slug for text and remember it.
True if the registry handed out exactly this slug.

spec: add: base = slugkit.slug.slugify(text, sep=self.sep); if base is '' use 'item'.
If base is not taken, take it. Otherwise try base + sep + '2', base + sep + '3', ... and take the first that is not taken.
'Taken' means handed out earlier by this registry (any earlier slug, including suffixed ones).
Registries are independent of each other (no class-level state).

examples.call: r = SlugRegistry(); r.add('Hello World'); r.add('hello world')
